ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) across the central and leading edge regions, with high-intensity (white) patches concentrated on the lateral lobes; estimated ratio of approximately 65:35 dark to light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs occupy the distal thirds of both lobes. The left lobe contains internal dark mottling and streaks. The right lobe features a larger white field with distinct dark linear marks. The central peduncle and medial fluke regions are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch; interior pixel angle approximately 50 degrees with a significant vertical depth relative to the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge span; pixel-amplitude of variations is most pronounced on the outer margins, resulting in a jagged, irregular profile against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edge (lower boundary) displays a smooth convex curve tapering upward to the tips. The trailing edge (upper boundary) follows a complex path defined by a primary concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast dark pixel clusters are visible at the terminal tips of both lobes and along the extreme trailing edges; likely corresponding to barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the high-intensity fields of both lobes; prominent parallel diagonal lines on the left lobe and vertical/oblique lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced linear rake marks across both ventral surfaces; highly irregular, jagged trailing edge indicative of cumulative tissue loss or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: An isolated dark circular spot is visible within the lower portion of the white high-intensity field on the left lobe.
